verdict.rationale: Eqvista's own docs list 'Board Resolutions & Voting' as a plan feature and claim integrated board management tools. They also describe built-in e-signing for equity agreements and centralized document management, so the core governance capability exists. But nothing shows consents being drafted from templates, stockholder approvals specifically, e-signature routing applied to resolutions, or approvals archived and linked to the transactions they authorize. Missing for 10: documented consent/resolution drafting, stockholder approval workflow, e-signature routing of board/stockholder consents, archiving linked to authorized transactions, independent or hands-on corroboration.
